Independent learning lab. MVC practice questions can differ from the actual exam. · ·

Sources & study notes

These are study questions adapted to New Jersey rules. The actual MVC exam can use different questions and wording. Use this New Jersey file when preparing for the New Jersey test.

  • NJ MVC: current driver manuals (September 2026 revision)
  • New Jersey Driver Manual
  • MVC sample questions and 50-question / 40-correct scoring
  • NJ law: parking and prohibited stopping or standing definitions, 39:1-1 and 39:4-138
  • NJ MVC: points and driving privileges
  • NJ MVC: driver programs and point reductions

The photographed signs illustrate the wording; their learning feedback uses New Jersey rules. The street, car and passenger are AI-created learning images. Read every actual sign and local restriction. In NJ, prohibited stopping or standing does not allow a voluntary passenger-drop-off stop.

Progress and complete new test reviews are stored on this browser. Use “Save my progress” to keep a portable backup. Earlier versions that saved scores alone cannot supply the original answers for review.

Farsi is a learning aid. Build the habit of reading the English first. This lab does not estimate when it is safe to drive after drinking.

Open your GitHub repository. Choose **Add file → Upload files**. 2. Upload `index.html`, `driver-lab.html`, and the entire `assets` folder **with its folder structure intact**. The simplest way is to drag the unzipped package contents onto the upload area, or use GitHub Desktop to add the folder and push. 3. Commit the uploaded files. Go to **Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main / (root)** and save. 4. Open the URL GitHub Pages displays after deployment. **Important:** Do not paste the old 39 MB HTML into GitHub. `index.html` is now a small editable page, while the CSS, JavaScript, photos, and narrated audio live in separate files. Uploading only `index.html` will not work. Keep the exact subfolder names. ## Playback The first screen is the large **Play** button over a blurred background. Clicking it starts the illustrated Farsi-narrated walkthrough automatically. Browser policies require that first click before sound can play. After closing the walkthrough, users can navigate the lessons normally. The Play screen returns on every new page load unless a timed exam is active. ## Keeping the site working Do not rename the `assets` folder, its media files, the numbered scripts, or `driver-lab.html` unless you also update references. Keep `index.html` at the root.
